Subject: Aligning on discovery: Redwood + Starlite technical kickoff

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. We’d love to run a focused discovery session next week to understand Starlite’s latency and data isolation priorities and to map an initial mutual action plan.

Attendees we propose:
- Priya (customer champion)
- Kunal Mehra (engineering lead) — if available
- Jordan Blake (AE, Redwood)
- Ava Chen (SE, Redwood) — will cover architecture and infra
- Diego Fernandez (optional SE for scale questions)

Suggested agenda (30–45 min):
1) Quick intros & goals (5)
2) Current infra/workloads & pain points (10)
3) Latency/cost constraints, security/compliance triggers (10)
4) Next steps / mutual action plan (5–10)

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed 7/15, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 7/15, 15:00–15:45
- Thu 7/16, 09:00–09:45

If none of those work, send a couple windows that do. I’ve cc’d Ava so she can flag any pre-reads we should share (short architecture doc + agenda).

Thanks — looking forward.

— Jordan
